description: The provided image is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of components within the MMAR benchmark, categorized into three main layers: Perception Layer (40.4%), Semantic Layer (41.2%), and Cultural Layer (14.1%). The largest segment, the Semantic Layer, is further divided into two subcategories: Content Analysis (41.2%) and Emotion & Intention. The Perception Layer is subdivided into Music Theory, Counting & Statistics, Environmental Perception & Reasoning, and Speaker Analysis. The Cultural Layer includes Professional Knowledge & Reasoning, Culture of Speaker, Imagination, and Acoustic Quality Analysis. The smallest segment, Signal Layer (4.3%), is part of the Semantic Layer and includes Anomaly Detection. The chart uses varying shades of blue to differentiate between the layers and subcategories, with labels and percentages clearly displayed within each segment. The overall structure visually emphasizes the dominance of the Semantic and Perception layers in the benchmark.
